items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; it is not certification. Risk severity is high for public launch and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private and preview-only launch gates, continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix, and permit only bounded reversible growth that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, affiliate, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, incident response readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Preserve existing private launch gates and do not create duplicate security work.
